markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Singleton conformal set and second-model agreement support it, but the two most similar cases are Invasive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 96%, Invasive 4% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 10% error | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 92nd percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Nearest two Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; concept model leans away from invasive · Validated [F4]
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score here; leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score here; fits in situ pattern · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction 81%** (regions 2, 9, 11) · context · Higher than 99% of reference; sampled regions only · Measured [F7]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is this case's largest concept term and unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Invasion may be underestimated: two most similar cases are Invasive; regions 2 and 9 show high regional risk.
- Calibration is imprecise (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18, n=132); treat 96% loosely.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 9:** confirm whether tumor stays duct-confined or breaches stroma (regional risk 84%, 60%).
2. **Regions 4, 10:** verify atypical cells are duct-confined; that concept's spot check was only 12/20.
3. **Region 11:** only 1 tumor nucleus counted; tumor-fraction value comes almost entirely from regions 2 and 9.
